analysis.title: Longevity weekly pulse #80: Reviewing 3Q26 health care earnings
key_insights: Eli Lilly reported a 3Q26 beat and raised 2026 revenue guidance by about 6% (about 5% excluding a one-time third-quarter benefit), driven by GLP-1 products across US and international markets and in both diabetes and obesity.
UBS expects forward consensus revenue and EPS estimates for LLY to move meaningfully higher for 2027-30 after the 3Q26 results.

Lilly's incretin pipeline could extend franchise durability into the 2040s and offset the Mounjaro/Zepbound patent expiration in 2036. UBS says this durability moderates long-term pressure on LLY's valuation.

Oral GLP-1 Foundayo missed consensus by about USD 40mn, small against the USD 1.1bn injectable GLP-1 outperformance. UBS sees US uptake limited near term by oral Wegovy's first-mover advantage and brand awareness.

Novartis beat 3Q26 EPS by 7%, helped by better cost control. It raised full-year core operating income guidance to flat to low-single-digit growth, from a low-single-digit decline, and kept low-single-digit sales growth guidance.

The main Novartis debate is whether newer growth drivers can offset patent expirations and sustain 5-6% constant-currency sales growth through 2030. New medium-term guidance comes at the CMD on 18-19 November.

Novartis growth drivers: Pluvicto should benefit from earlier-stage prostate cancer expansion starting in 4Q, with more acceleration in 2027. Rhapsido peak-sales expectation was raised to more than USD 4bn.
Leqvio has two cardiovascular outcomes trials ahead: ORION-4 expected to read out in 4Q26 and VICTORION-2-PREVENT in 2027. Management expressed confidence both will be positive.

Novartis core margins are expected to fall sequentially in 4Q and face pressure over the next couple of years as US Xolair biosimilars cut high-margin royalty revenue. Management still targets a 40% core operating margin by 2029 at the latest.

Roche 3Q26 sales grew 7% at constant exchange rates (CER), 2% ahead of consensus. Diagnostics was broadly in line despite China pricing pressure. FY26 guidance is unchanged at mid-single-digit sales growth and high-single-digit core EPS growth at CER.

Roche management views consensus giredestrant sales of CHF 500-600mn next year as reasonable. UBS sees peak sales potential of CHF 10bn for giredestrant, and Vabysmo remains on track for low-double-digit growth with a CHF 6bn peak-sales ambition.
Galderma 3Q26 sales beat consensus by 5%, with all three divisions ahead. Group sales grew 26% at CER to USD 1.63bn.
Galderma raised 2026 organic sales growth guidance from 19-21% to 22.5-23.5%, about 2% above consensus at the midpoint, and kept the roughly 26% core EBITDA margin target.

Galderma's Nemluvio holds about 45% share in prurigo nodularis and about 9% in atopic dermatitis, has turned profitable, and management sees a path to more than USD 1bn in global sales this year. Management pushed back on the IQVIA prescription-data read-across.

Galderma's ZO Skin Health acquisition is expected to be earnings-accretive from 2028. Relfydess still has outstanding FDA manufacturing issues, though management cited progress at Uppsala after a Type A meeting.
UBS says the 3Q26 results reinforce a constructive sector view, with healthy underlying growth, improving earnings visibility and supportive product and pipeline momentum.

market_movers.rationale: Strong 3Q26 beat and guidance raise on GLP-1 strength. UBS expects consensus estimates for 2027-30 to move meaningfully higher and sees upside to consensus.
7% EPS beat on cost control and a raised core operating income outlook. UBS reiterates a positive stance, with the CMD on 18-19 November as the next catalyst.
Roche: sales 2% above consensus with a constructive setup into 2027, driven by giredestrant, Vabysmo and fenebrutinib. UBS keeps its constructive view.
Galderma: broad-based 5% sales beat and a sizable guidance upgrade. UBS calls it 'as good as could reasonably have been hoped for'.

sector_views.rationale: UBS describes a constructive view across the sector, with healthy underlying growth, improving earnings visibility and supportive product and pipeline momentum.

earnings_insights: Eli Lilly 3Q26 (already reported): adjusted revenue growth of about 34%, 4% above consensus. EPS growth of 46%, 23% above expectations, adjusted for one-time items.
Eli Lilly raised 2026 revenue guidance by about 6%, or about 5% excluding a one-time third-quarter benefit.
Eli Lilly oral GLP-1 Foundayo (reported) missed consensus by about USD 40mn. Injectable GLP-1 sales beat consensus by about USD 1.1bn.

Novartis 3Q26 (already reported): EPS beat consensus by 7%. Full-year core operating income guidance raised to flat to low-single-digit growth from a low-single-digit decline. Sales growth guidance maintained at low-single-digit.
Roche 3Q26 (already reported): 7% CER sales growth, 2% ahead of consensus. FY26 guidance maintained at mid-single-digit sales growth and high-single-digit core EPS growth at CER.

Galderma 3Q26 (already reported): group sales up 26% CER to USD 1.63bn, 5% ahead of consensus. 2026 organic sales growth guidance raised to 22.5-23.5% from 19-21%, with the new range about 2% above consensus at the midpoint. Core EBITDA margin target of about 26% retained.
risk_factors: Lilly: pipeline failures and more severe than expected pricing pressure, plus legislative and regulatory changes.

Novartis: weaker commercial success of key products, generic erosion, Cosentyx competition, lower expectations for cardiovascular launches and a miss on medium-term margin targets. Near-term core margin pressure from Xolair biosimilars.
Roche: lower Vabysmo penetration with the Eylea 8mg competitor launch, Ocrevus competition from Kesimpta and BTK inhibitors, and HER2 competition from new entrants.
Galderma: slower Nemluvio launch given US payer coverage hurdles, consumer slowdown in self-pay markets, and unresolved FDA manufacturing issues for Relfydess.
Foundayo US uptake limited near term by oral Wegovy's first-mover advantage.

tension_points.bull_case: Newer drivers (Pluvicto, Rhapsido, Leqvio) can sustain 5-6% constant-currency sales growth. Management sees less generic pressure in 2027 and expects positive Leqvio outcomes trials.
tension_points.bear_case: Core margins are expected to fall sequentially in 4Q, with pressure over the next couple of years as US Xolair biosimilars reduce high-margin royalty and other revenue.
tension_points.what_invalidates: New medium-term guidance at the CMD on 18-19 November, or a negative ORION-4 readout expected in 4Q26, would test the growth thesis.

tension_points.bull_case: Injectable GLP-1 outperformance of USD 1.1bn dwarfs the small oral shortfall. Foundayo should gain share over time internationally and as the market grows.
tension_points.bear_case: Oral Wegovy's first-mover advantage and brand awareness limit Foundayo's US performance near term.
